requirements.title: Receipt-backed native platform qualification
requirements.description: Native control-plane volume identity/check/repair/mount and DBM backup/scratch-restore executions produce privacy-safe platform receipts. The support matrix qualifies only the latest native receipt for each platform and capability; fixtures and cross-builds remain unqualified. Completion additionally requires real native receipts on Linux, macOS and Windows, including scratch restore on macOS and Windows.

validation.notes: The file sink records hashed operation/proof references and host identity without raw target, destination, proof, or volume identity values.
Generator imports control-plane and DBM runtime ledgers, validates receipt fields, scopes qualification by platform/capability, and excludes fixtures and cross-builds.

Record real Linux, minimouse macOS, and operator-provided Windows identity/check/repair/mount/backup/scratch-restore receipts, then regenerate and review the matrix and one evidence-based format decision.
